claims.visible_claim: This page places Agreeableness—cooperation, trust, and consideration for others—within the Big Five continuous-domain framework ([S1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2283588/)). The six facets below use NEO/IPIP-NEO vocabulary. The official IPIP resource says its scales measure constructs similar to NEO facets, while the BFI-2 uses a different 15-facet architecture ([S11](https://ipip.ori.org/Finding_Scales_to_Measure_Particular_Constructs.htm); [S2](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27055049/)). These labels must not be treated as fully equivalent across instruments.
claims.boundary: Supports the continuous domain and facet vocabulary, not morality, scale equivalence, or product validity.
